api_action_policy.permitted_post_justification: POST /v1/retrieve and POST /v1/query use POST only because they carry a request body. Neither changes the corpus, the registry or the ACL store. They are the only two POSTs this work may issue.
api_action_policy.posture: READ-ONLY against a shared multi-tenant production service.
prohibited_absolutely: POST /v1/ingest and POST /v1/ingest/upload -- would mutate a shared corpus and consume embedding budget
POST /v1/collections and DELETE /v1/collections/{id} -- would consume the per-owner collection quota and can irreversibly purge physical stores
POST /v1/collections/{id}/purge semantics via the purge=true query flag -- irreversibly destroys embeddings
POST /v1/collections/{id}/graph -- submits an LLM-per-chunk extraction workflow, as the caller, at roughly ten times embed cost
POST /v1/collections/{id}/restore -- submits a workflow and can evict another collection when capacity is full
DELETE /v1/documents/{doc_id} -- targets the caller's implicitly resolved default collection
all share, group and ownership mutations
all /v1/grading mutations, including batch creation, verdicts and adjudication -- these belong to a human inter-reader reliability protocol and must not be written by an automated run
POST /v1/stats/models/benchmark -- drives load against shared model endpoints

credential_policy.error_handling: Redact the Authorization header before recording any failed request. A recorded request keeps the header name with a fixed redaction marker, never the value.
prohibited: printing, echoing or logging the token or any substring of it
writing the token into any result file, table, leaderboard, checkpoint, cache, prompt, or committed script
including the token in any typed status update, measurement, evidence record, or progress envelope returned to the host or the Duet
copying the token to any path outside /Users/me/.patric_token
transmitting the token to any host other than www.bv-brc.org, including the Episode model under the operator exception
storing the token in an environment variable that is dumped by any diagnostic or error handler
credential_policy.read_rule: Read the file contents at request time, inside the process that issues the HTTP call. Bind the value to the Authorization header and use it for nothing else.
credential_policy.status: live BV-BRC identity token belonging to the operator
credential_policy.verification: Before the run is reported complete, grep every written artifact for the token's first and last eight characters. Fail the run if either appears.

data_handling_policy.corpus_content: Retrieved ASM paper chunk text may be written into run artifacts as evidence, quoted spans and citations. It is scholarly literature already indexed in the tenant.
data_handling_policy.episode_model_minimisation: Chunk text sent to the Episode's own model under the operator exception is limited to the chunks and answers needed for the specific question-generation, validation or judging step. Whole documents or collections are never sent in bulk.
data_handling_policy.no_reingestion: Locally cached corpus text is evidence for scoring only. It must never be pushed back into any collection.
data_handling_policy.volume_discipline: Store chunk_id and doc_id as the durable reference. Quote only the span that supports a scored judgement. Do not mirror whole collections to local disk.

required_before_proceeding: any situation that appears to require a write to the tenant
discovery that the token grants admin role on this deployment
discovery that the only readable collection is not an ASM paper collection
any scored result that would be reported without an answer key, where the run would otherwise substitute model self-assessment for ground truth

resolved_by_operator.answer_key_item: Resolved by operator decision q_answer_key. Corpus-generated, frozen, validated multi-paper gold evidence sets are the ground truth. This trigger fires only if a collection's gold sets cannot be frozen and validated, and the collection then closes as blocked (benchmark_not_freezable).

prohibited: modifying or deleting any pre-existing file in the repository
writing outside the scratch directory for temporary files; temporary files belong under /Users/me/.hermes/cache/scratch
local_filesystem_policy.writable_subtree: a single run-scoped results directory beneath that root, created by the run and named in the deliverable

operator_exception_episode_model.decision: Operator decision, recorded in the Duet: ASM paper text may be sent to the executing Episode's own model.
not_covered: any tenant, provider or third-party model endpoint reached by the run's code over HTTP
sending the token, any request header, or any credential material to the model
sending chunk text for any purpose other than those listed
permitted_purposes: generating benchmark questions and required-evidence-item lists from retrieved chunks
validating that a synthesis question cannot be answered from any single document
judging synthesis completeness and citation support of tenant answers against gold evidence and resolved chunks
operator_exception_episode_model.scope: Only the Episode's own model, reached through the Episode's normal model channel, not by HTTP from the run's code. Only for the purposes listed.

prohibited: any other RAGstack tenant, specifically dev, lucid-next and hackathon
any other host from the run's code
sending retrieved corpus content to any model endpoint other than (a) the tenant's own per-request llm override and (b) the Episode's own model under operator_exception_episode_model

rate_and_load_policy.abort_condition: If more than 25 percent of requests in any rolling window of 20 fail, stop issuing requests, record the condition, and return a typed status reporting infrastructure failure. Do not retry into a degraded shared service.
rate_and_load_policy.backoff: On 429, honour the Retry-After header exactly when it is 900 seconds or less. On 503, back off exponentially starting at 5 seconds, for at most 5 attempts, then abandon that trial and record it as an infrastructure failure, not an answer failure.
rate_and_load_policy.stats_polling: Call GET /v1/stats/tenants with counts=true at most once per run; prefer counts=false. Do not poll /v1/stats/stores or /v1/collections more often than once every 15 seconds.

tenant_budget_exhaustion.context: Operator statement: the tenant budget resets on Monday. Once it is exhausted, no further tenant work is possible until then.
tenant_budget_exhaustion.detection: Any of the following: HTTP 402; HTTP 429 with Retry-After above 900 seconds; HTTP 403 or 429 whose body mentions quota, budget, limit exceeded or credits; or two consecutive query responses that return the retrieval-only placeholder after real answers had been returned earlier in the run.
tenant_budget_exhaustion.response: Stop ALL tenant calls run-wide immediately; do not retry and do not wait. Record the triggering response (status, Retry-After, body excerpt, never headers containing credentials) and the timestamp. Write the resumable checkpoint defined in the operator addendum. Close the in-progress collection and every unstarted collection as bound_hit with bound tenant_budget_exhausted_until_monday, and proceed to root close-out. This is never reported as convergence and never counted as an answer failure.

reporting_policy.bound_vs_convergence: A run ended by any declared bound -- iteration cap, elapsed-time cap, request-error abort, tenant budget exhaustion or call ceiling -- must be reported as bound_hit. It must never be reported as convergence or as a completed search of the parameter space.
reporting_policy.negative_results: A parameter axis that could not be tested, for example use_graph on a tenant whose graph store reports available=false, must be recorded as not-tested, never as no-effect.
reporting_policy.no_fabrication: Every reported score must trace to recorded per-question outcome rows with resolvable chunk_id citations. A summary figure with no underlying rows is prohibited.

content.revision_note: Revision 2. Supersedes context_ad4a4e63addc286610dc21ed99fdd68d95de8c25d1aa01b1cbe3c56ecf894f1b. Operator decisions added: (a) an explicit exception allowing ASM paper text to go to the Episode's own model for question generation, validation and judging only; (b) handling for tenant budget exhaustion (the budget resets on Monday): stop at once and checkpoint, with no waiting or retrying, and a cap on how long Retry-After is honoured; (c) the answer-key escalation item marked as resolved by operator decision q_answer_key. Nothing else is loosened.
content.scope: Binds every descendant Episode the Creator designs for this work. The Creator may not design a workflow that violates any rule here, and may not delegate a capability that makes a prohibited action reachable.
content.title: Safety policy for the BV-BRC RAGstack asm-next configuration experiment (rev 2)
